name: Open-front picking bin 200 x 145 x 130 mm
description:
A small open-front picking bin, the shelf-mounted parts bin found on pick faces, workshop racking and line-side supply trolleys everywhere. The front wall stands at roughly 40% of the back wall's height with the side walls sweeping down between them on a curve, so an operator can reach in and pick without lifting the bin off the shelf.

External dimensions: depth 200 mm, width 145 mm, height 130 mm.

No dimensional standard governs this family; sizes are manufacturer-specific. These three are typical of the commonly stocked small/medium/large range.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 1,488 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Open-front picking bin, small - 200 x 145 x 130 mm true-scale GLB of a standard shelf/parts bin for warehouse and workshop storage.
